<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">cd /tmp && python3 << 'EOF'
# Calculate 13^10
result = 13 ** 10
print(f"13^10 = {result}")

# Convert to string to get individual digits
digits_str = str(result)
print(f"Digits: {digits_str}")

# Sum the digits
digit_sum = sum(int(digit) for digit in digits_str)
print(f"Sum of digits: {digit_sum}")

EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">cd /tmp && python3 << 'EOF'
# Calculate 13^10 step by step
power = 13 ** 10
print(f"13^10 = {power}")

# Get the digits
digits = [int(d) for d in str(power)]
print(f"Individual digits: {digits}")

# Sum them
total = sum(digits)
print(f"Sum: {' + '.join(map(str, digits))} = {total}")

EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
